question: Who among the following Indian shooter won a gold in the 10 m air rifle category in 2018 ISSF Junior World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elavenil Valarivan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Elavenil Valarivan won a gold in the 10 m air rifle category in 2018 ISSF Junior World Cup.
 
• She became the third Indian shooter after Apurvi Chandela and Anjali Bhagwat to win the gold medal at the senior ISSF World Cup in the 10m Air Rifle category.
 
• She defeated Seonaid Mcintosh from Great Britain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e348045f066dde095db2d44aedc53a7e60d5e6640f39b7250fee3b2cd9396dc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahi Sarnobat **competes in the 25-metre pistol shooting event.
 
• **Aparajita Singh** is from Madhya Pradesh and competes in 50m-rifle event in nationals
 
• **Anisa Sayyed **is a female pistol shooter who won two gold medals in the 2010 Commonwealth Games.
 
 
• She also won a gold medal at the SAF games in 2006.
 
• She won a silver in the 25m event at the 2014 Commonwealth Games.
